stem:
The diagram shows a ray of light reflected from a plane mirror in Shreya’s optics activity. Angles at the point of incidence are labelled P, Q, R and S.

Which pair are the angle of incidence and the angle of reflection?

teacher.key_rationale: Incidence and reflection are measured from the normal, so Q (incident–normal) and R (reflected–normal). P and S are from the mirror surface; mixing surface angles with normal angles is incorrect.
teacher.figure_note: Plane mirror with normal; P,S from surface; Q,R from normal.
